To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a TMD improved several HDL functions in humans, especially in those at high cardiovascular risk.
the TMD improves HDL athero-protective functions in high-risk individuals.
the TMD, especially enriched with virgin olive oils, improved the functions of HDL in humans.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effects of the Mediterranean diet on the quality and functionality of the HDL particles.
the effects of a long-term dietary intervention based on the TMD on HDL athero-protective functions.
understanding the mechanisms that underlie the cardioprotector effects of a Mediterranean diet.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
both TMDs improved HDL function, but TMD-VOOs induced greater improvements than did TMD-Nuts in cholesterol efflux capacity and cholesteryl-ester transfer protein activity.
a TMD improves the biological functions of HDL in individuals at high cardiovascular risk.
the Mediterranean diet improves HDL function in high-risk individuals.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have shown that the TMD, especially enriched in virgin olive oil, improves the atheroprotected functions of high-density loprotein (HDL) particles in high-cardiovascular-risk individuals, and that this effect is mediated by the improved oxidative status and lipid/protein composition of HDL particles.
a Mediterranean diet improves HDL function in high-risk individuals.
a Mediterranean diet, especially enriched with extra-virgin olive oil, improves the atheroprotector function of high-density lipoproten (HDL).
The main takeaway from our work is that

the Mediterranean diet, and especially when enriched with olive oil, can improve high-density lipoprotein atheroprotector functions, including reverse cholesterol transport and antioxidant properties.
the Mediterranean diet improves the biological function of HDL, and that this improvement is related to changes in HDL particle size, lipid and protein composition and oxidative status.
the Mediterranean Diet is not just about weight loss or cholesterol levels
